metricText: USAspending aggregated_amount of Assistance Listing 95.001 HIDTA prime financial-assistance award transactions for a complete federal fiscal year.
note: VERIFIED, BROADER CONTEXT SCOPE: the exact FY2025 query returned $271,657,675.60 in net award-transaction obligations for the whole Assistance Listing 95.001 aggregate. This does not isolate section 707(s) supplemental competitive grants, whose Wave-1 request remains rejected, and it does not measure all HIDTA financial-account obligations, outlays, appropriations, budget authority, or bill-caused spending.
publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, USAspending
statisticalProduct: USAspending API v2 advanced search, financial-assistance award transactions filtered to Assistance Listing 95.001 and grouped by fiscal year

verification.reason: A fresh official Assistance Listing lookup identifies 95.001 as High Intensity Drug Trafficking Areas Program, and the exact transaction-level query returns one complete FY2025 row. A same-session replay returned byte-identical evidence. Complete hasNext=false listing and awarding-subagency cross-checks each sum to the same $271,657,675.60. This verifies the broader AL-wide award-transaction aggregate only. It does not reverse the Wave-1 rejection in drafts/ledger-ingestion/usaspending-ondcp-hidta-supplemental-grant-obligations.json: USAspending exposes no structured field that distinguishes the narrower section 707(s) supplemental competitive grants, so title or description text matching remains inadmissible.

scope.verifiedConcept: Signed net federal_action_obligation aggregated across prime financial-assistance award transactions whose Assistance Listing is 95.001, grouped by action-date federal fiscal year.
scope.contextForBill: This recurring AL-wide aggregate is contextual HIDTA program execution spending. S. 767's bill-mapped fiscal metric is the narrower use of section 707(s) supplemental grants; the aggregate cannot identify that subset or spending under any newly permitted purpose.
excludes: section 707(s) supplemental competitive grants as a separately identified subset
grants tagged to the bill's proposed new investigation, interdiction, prevention, or other purposes
appropriations, enacted budget authority, the $333 million authorization, or the $14.224 million supplemental-grant ceiling

standingWave1Rejection.distinction: Assistance Listing 95.001 covers the broader HIDTA program. Returned award identity and description fields do not provide an objective section 707(s) supplemental-grant flag, and text matching cannot create one. The new AL-wide context series therefore leaves the narrower rejection unchanged.

firstPrint.basis: USAspending revises continuously. The retrospective FY2025 fetch verifies the query shape and historical value but is not first-print evidence. A forecast target must define the outcome as the exact registered query response captured inside a preregistered post-fiscal-year snapshot window and archive the complete response bytes, following the existing USAspending adapter custody rule.

adapterDisposition.requiredWork: Extend the existing fiscal_year_post_scalar registered-query builder to accept a sealed programNumbers transform and emit filters.program_numbers; add the HIDTA series binding and parser tests while preserving registered_query_snapshot release policy and complete raw-response custody. No new source family is required.

parseNotes: Use program_numbers=["95.001"] as the registered series identity. Do not isolate section 707(s) grants by matching award titles or descriptions; the Wave-1 rejection establishes that no admissible structured discriminator was found.

Do not add an ONDCP awarding-subagency filter. The complete FY2025 category response assigns 255,578,126.0 to the Executive Office of the President row and 16,079,549.6 to the Office of National Drug Control Policy row; together they exactly reproduce the AL-wide aggregate. The ondcp concept namespace identifies the HIDTA program context, not a subagency filter.

The FY2025 response reports 271,657,675.6 entirely in Grant_Obligations, with every other obligation bucket equal to zero and all outlay fields null. This describes this response only and does not convert the series into all-account obligations or outlays.
Treat aggregated_amount as a signed net award-transaction obligation total for the complete action-date fiscal year; retain deobligations rather than summing absolute award amounts.
Do not relabel the aggregate as section 707(s) supplemental grants, spending under S. 767's proposed new purposes, enacted budget authority, appropriations, authorization, or causal policy impact.
